class Controller:
 def __init__(self,s):
  self.s=s;self.m=s.model;self.d=s.data

 def ik(self,p,R,q=None):
  if q is None:q=self.q.copy()
  else:q=q.copy()
  for _ in range(80):
   self.k.qpos[:]=self.d.qpos;self.k.qpos[self.s._jq]=q
   mujoco.mj_kinematics(self.m,self.k);mujoco.mj_comPos(self.m,self.k)
   ep=p-self.k.xpos[self.h];er=Rot.from_matrix(R@self.k.xmat[self.h].reshape(3,3).T).as_rotvec()
   if np.linalg.norm(ep)<1e-5 and np.linalg.norm(er)<1e-4:break
   mujoco.mj_jacBody(self.m,self.k,self.jp,self.jr,self.h)
   J=np.vstack([self.jp[:,self.s._jv[:7]],self.jr[:,self.s._jv[:7]]])
   e=np.r_[ep,er];dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+np.eye(6)*1e-5,e)
   dq*=min(1,.15/max(abs(dq)))
   q[:7]=np.clip(q[:7]+dq,self.s.lower[:7],self.s.upper[:7])
  return q
 def move(self,p,R,hand=None,n=120):
  p0,R0=self.pose();q0=self.q.copy()
  if hand is None:hand=q0[7:].copy()
  dr=Rot.from_matrix(R@R0.T).as_rotvec()
  for i in range(n):
   t=(i+1)/n;t=t*t*(3-2*t)
   self.q=self.ik(p0+(p-p0)*t,Rot.from_rotvec(dr*t).as_matrix()@R0)
   self.q[7:]=q0[7:]+(hand-q0[7:])*t

 def hold(self,n=60):
  for _ in range(n):self.s.step(self.q)
 def report(self,name,render=False):

  cs=[]
  for c in self.d.contact:
   a,b=int(c.geom1),int(c.geom2)
   if self.m.geom_bodyid[a]==self.s._obj or self.m.geom_bodyid[b]==self.s._obj:

    cs.append((self.m.geom(a).name,self.m.geom(b).name,round(float(c.dist),4)))
  print('contacts',cs,flush=True)
